200.title: Poland and Finland Drive Europe’s F-35 Shift From Russian Jets
200.summary: Finland’s F-35s to Replace Hornets on NATO’s Northern Flank While Poland begins operating its F-35s, Finland is preparing to receive its first aircraft under a 64-jet program chosen in 2021 to replace its Boeing F/A-18 Hornet fleet.
200.body: Poland Receives First F-35s and Retires MiG-29 Fleet Recent deliveries of F-35A Lightning II fighters to Poland mark a major milestone in NATO’s eastern air defenses. Finland’s F-35s to Replace Hornets on NATO’s Northern Flank While Poland begins operating its F-35s, Finland is preparing to receive its first aircraft under a 64-jet program chosen in 2021 to replace its Boeing F/A-18 Hornet fleet. From Soviet Designs to a Western Fifth-Generation Standard Poland’s and Finland’s F-35 decisions sit within a wider European pattern of moving away from Soviet and Russian fighter designs that once populated many inventories. Bases in countries such as Poland and Finland previously associated with legacy Soviet or early-generation Western fighters will feature stealth aircraft and multinational F-35 deployments, reflecting closer security cooperation with North American and European partners.

200.title: Zelensky signs law on memorial to heroes despite protest from Poland
200.summary: "The Ukrainian pantheon will definitely be built, and only Ukrainians will decide who is a hero for us," Zelensky reaffirmed on Saturday before war veterans. A rift between the two countries had already emerged in June after Zelensky awarded a military unit the honorary title "Heroes of the UPA." Warsaw subsequently withdrew the Order of the White Eagle it had awarded to Zelensky.
200.body: The so-called pantheon is set to honour members of the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA), nationalist underground fighters who were responsible for the mass murder of Poles and Jews - primarily in Volyn in what is now western Ukraine - during the German occupation in World War II, with tens of thousands of victims. "The Ukrainian pantheon will definitely be built, and only Ukrainians will decide who is a hero for us," Zelensky reaffirmed on Saturday before war veterans. After the Ukrainian parliament passed the law in July, the office of Polish President Karol Nawrocki said that from Poland's perspective, glorifying criminals who had committed genocide in Volyn was not the path to the western world. A rift between the two countries had already emerged in June after Zelensky awarded a military unit the honorary title "Heroes of the UPA." Warsaw subsequently withdrew the Order of the White Eagle it had awarded to Zelensky.

300.title: Polish team takes fourth place in global humanoid robot tournament
300.summary: Humanoid robot fighting tournament, photo credit: PAP/EPA/ANDRES MARTINEZ CASARES A seven-member Polish team has taken fourth place among 200 teams in the qualifying rounds of the URKL 2026 humanoid robot tournament, achieving the best result by a European team.
300.body: Humanoid robot fighting tournament, photo credit: PAP/EPA/ANDRES MARTINEZ CASARES A seven-member Polish team has taken fourth place among 200 teams in the qualifying rounds of the URKL 2026 humanoid robot tournament, achieving the best result by a European team. The Brave Mind Fighters team will compete in the next stage of the tournament in Shenzhen, China, in August, when the robots will fight in the ring. URKL 2026, or Ultimate Robot Knock-out Legend, is an international humanoid robot fighting league initiated and organised in Shenzhen by Chinese humanoid robot manufacturer EngineAI. The team trained the robot using PPO, or Proximal Policy Optimization, an algorithm that teaches a robot a strategy by rewarding desired behaviour such as stability, following the reference movement, smoothness and completing a task.
